senses.sense_definition: The principal, most anterior, and largest part of the brain in vertebrates, located in the front area of the skull and responsible for sensory integration, voluntary movement, and higher mental functions.

examples.text: The human <w>cerebrum</w> is divided into two distinct hemispheres separated by a deep fissure.
Higher cognitive processes such as reasoning and memory take place within the <w>cerebrum</w>.
